reportsModuleConfiguration.listQuery:
PREFIX eccc: <https://vocab.eccenca.com/controlling/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX s: <http://schema.org/>
SELECT
  ?worker
  (SUM(?duration) AS ?totalDuration)
  (SUM(?research) AS ?researchDuration)
  (SUM(?customer) AS ?customerDuration)
  (SUM(?absence) AS ?absenceDuration)
  (COUNT(DISTINCT STR(?date)) AS ?days)
FROM <https://timetracker.eccenca.com/records/>
WHERE {
  ?_resource a ?activity .
  ?activity rdfs:subClassOf eccc:Activity .
  ?_resource s:performer ?worker .
  ?_resource s:startDate ?date .
  ?_resource s:duration ?duration .
  BIND(IF(?activity = eccc:ResearchActivity, ?duration, 0 ) AS ?research)
  BIND(IF(?activity = eccc:CustomerProjectActivity, ?duration, 0 ) AS ?customer)
  BIND(IF(?activity IN(
    eccc:Illness, eccc:IllnessWithCertificate, eccc:ParentalLeave,
    eccc:Vacation, eccc:VacationByLaw, eccc:VacationSpecial
  ), ?duration, 0 ) AS ?absence)
  FILTER ( ?date >= {{LOWER_DATE}}^^xsd:date )
  FILTER ( ?date <= {{UPPER_DATE}}^^xsd:date )
}
GROUP BY ?worker
ORDER BY DESC(?days)

trackingModuleConfiguration.listQuery:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX eccc: <https://vocab.eccenca.com/controlling/>
PREFIX s: <http://schema.org/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?resource (?resource as ?edit) ?date ?duration ?activity ?projectOrOrganization
FROM <https://timetracker.eccenca.com/>
WHERE {
  ?resource a ?activity .
  ?activity rdfs:subClassOf eccc:Activity .
  ?resource s:performer <https://ns.eccenca.com/{{shuiAccountName}}> .
  ?resource s:startDate ?date .
  ?resource s:duration ?duration .
  OPTIONAL { ?resource s:superEvent ?project . }
  OPTIONAL { ?resource eccc:relatedOrganization ?organization . }
  BIND(COALESCE(?project, ?organization) AS ?projectOrOrganization).
  FILTER (?date >= "{{LOWER_DATE}}"^^xsd:date)
  FILTER (?date <= "{{UPPER_DATE}}"^^xsd:date)
}
ORDER BY desc(?date)
trackingModuleConfiguration.activitiesQuery:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX eccc: <https://vocab.eccenca.com/controlling/>
SELECT ?resource ?label WHERE {
  ?resource a owl:Class .
  ?resource rdfs:subClassOf eccc:Activity .
  ?resource rdfs:label ?label .
}
ORDER BY (?label)

navigationConfiguration.conceptParentChildQuery:
# Computes the class hierarchy forest used by the navigation list.
# Each result links a resource to its direct parent and tree root.
#
# ?topResource: root of the tree containing the resource
# ?resource: a node in the tree
# ?parentResource: direct parent of the node
#
# Note: SELECT must be exactly ?topResource, ?resource, and ?parentResource.
# No rebinding, aliases, or expressions allowed in the projection.
SELECT DISTINCT ?topResource ?resource ?parentResource
WHERE {
  {

    # Get explicit parent resources
    ?resource rdfs:subClassOf ?parentResource .
  } UNION {

    # Get implicit parent resources
    ?resource (owl:equivalentClass | rdfs:subClassOf) ?complexParentClass .
    ?complexParentClass owl:intersectionOf ?parentClassExpression .
    ?parentClassExpression rdf:rest*/rdf:first ?parentResource .
  }

  # Ensure that the parent resource is not a complex class expression
  FILTER isIRI(?parentResource)

  # Get intermediate resources on the path to the root
  ?parentResource (

    # Explicit intermediate path elements
    rdfs:subClassOf |

    # Implicit intermediate path elements
    ((owl:equivalentClass | rdfs:subClassOf)* / owl:intersectionOf / rdf:rest* / rdf:first)

    # Evaluate path elements transitively
  )* ?intermediateResource .

  # Ensure that intermediate resources are not complex class expressions
  FILTER isIRI(?intermediateResource)

  {
    # Get explicit root resources
    ?intermediateResource rdfs:subClassOf* ?topResource .
  } UNION {

    # Get implicit root resources
    ?intermediateResource (owl:equivalentClass | rdfs:subClassOf)* ?complexTopClass .
    ?complexTopClass owl:intersectionOf ?topClassExpression .
    ?topClassExpression rdf:rest*/rdf:first ?topResource .
  }

  # Ensure that the root resource is not a complex class expression
  FILTER isIRI(?topResource)

  # Placeholder for future use
  {{VALUES}}
}

facets.query:
# Computes an instance count facet for each resource.
#
# ?resource: the resource whose instances are counted
# ?instanceCount: number of instances of the resource and its subclasses
#
# Note: SELECT must be exactly ?resource and ?instanceCount.
# No rebinding, aliases, or expressions allowed in the projection.
SELECT ?resource (COUNT(?instance) AS ?instanceCount) {

  # Get all instances of the resource and its subclasses
  ?instance rdf:type/rdfs:subClassOf* ?resource .

  # Restrict bindings to context-relevant resources
  {{VALUES}}

# Count instances for each resource
} GROUP BY ?resource

facets.query:
# Computes an outgoing property count facet for each resource.
#
# ?resource: the resource whose outgoing properties are counted
# ?propertyCount: number of outgoing properties of the resource
#
# Note: SELECT must be exactly ?resource and ?propertyCount.
# No rebinding, aliases, or expressions allowed in the projection.
SELECT ?resource (COUNT(?p) AS ?propertyCount) {

  # Get all triples with the resource as subject
  ?resource ?p ?value .

  # Restrict bindings to context-relevant resources
  {{VALUES}}

# Count outgoing properties for each resource
} GROUP BY ?resource

facets.query:
# Computes a "latest modification date" facet for each resource.
#
# ?resource: the resource with modification dates
# ?lastModified: latest modification date of the resource
#
# Note: SELECT must be exactly ?resource and ?lastModified.
# No rebinding, aliases, or expressions allowed in the projection.
SELECT ?resource (MAX(?mDate) AS ?lastModified)
WHERE {

  # Get modification dates of the resources
  ?resource dcterms:modified ?mDate .

  # Restrict bindings to context-relevant resources
  {{VALUES}}

# Compute the latest modification date per resource
} GROUP BY ?resource

facets.query:
# Computes a "system resource" facet for each resource.
# System resources belong to the eCMEM bootstrap data and may change or be
# deleted when eCMEM is bootstrapped again.
#
# ?resource: the resource to check
# ?systemResource: whether the resource belongs to the bootstrap data
#
# Note: SELECT must be exactly ?resource and ?systemResource.
# No rebinding, aliases, or expressions allowed in the projection.
SELECT DISTINCT ?resource ?systemResource {

  # Get the system resource flag, if present
  OPTIONAL { ?resource shui:isSystemResource ?isSys . }

  # Default to false if the flag is absent
  BIND(COALESCE(STR(?isSys), "false") AS ?systemResource)

  # Restrict bindings to context-relevant resources
  {{VALUES}}
}

facets.query:
# Computes a class facet for each resource, displaying the resource's class
# name as a badge.
#
# ?resource: the resource whose class is retrieved
# ?hasClass: a class of the resource
#
# Note: SELECT must be exactly ?resource and ?hasClass.
# No rebinding, aliases, or expressions allowed in the projection.
SELECT DISTINCT ?resource ?hasClass {

  # Get all class assignments of a resource
  ?resource a ?hasClass .

  # Restrict bindings to context-relevant resources
  {{VALUES}}
}
